afterz-533.description: Vẽ một đường vát cong mịn phía trong các cạnh của các phần mờ của lớp.

afterz-535.name: [Z+] Colorful LinesTunnel
afterz-535.description: Generates a tunnel of colorful glowing lines.

afterz-539.name: [Z+] Truchet Checkerboard
afterz-539.description: Generates an animated Truchet checkerboard pattern.

afterz-547.name: [Z+] Old Sharpen V2
afterz-547.description: Sharpen like S_Sharpen in After Effect

afterz-551.name: [Z+] New Lensflare
afterz-551.description: Adds a lens flare with reflections.

afterz-555.name: [Z+] Point Tunnel
afterz-555.description: Generates a tunnel of glowing points that moves forward or in reverse.

afterz-556.name: [Z+] Edge Line
afterz-556.description: Tìm các cạnh trong lớp ảnh hoặc video bằng cách phát hiện những thay đổi rõ ràng về độ sáng giữa các pixel lân cận.

afterz-561.name: [Z+] Optic Compensation
afterz-561.description: Bends the layer like a wide angle lens with chromatic separation.

afterz-562.name: [Z+] Preset Filters
afterz-562.description: Applies preset cinematic color filters like Teal and Orange, Moody Blue and Vintage.

afterz-563.name: [Z+] Turbulent Pro
afterz-563.description: Warp image using fractal noise (FBM) or curl noise, similar to Adobe After Effects Turbulent Displace

afterz-564.name: [Z+] Cosmic Starfield
afterz-564.description: Generates a cosmic starfield with twinkling and burst stars.

afterz-566.name: [Z+] Plexus Particle+
afterz-566.description: Generates a plexus of connected particles.

afterz-568.name: [Z+] Box Blur+
afterz-568.description: Làm mờ lớp bằng cách lấy giá trị trung bình các màu của các pixel lân cận trong một vùng hình chữ nhật xung quanh (từ đó làm nhòe dạng hộp).

afterz-570.name: [Z+] Fade Noise
afterz-570.description: Reveals or hides the layer with a stepped noise fade.

afterz-572.name: [Z+] Chromatic Lensflare
afterz-572.description: Adds a chromatic lens flare with halo.

afterz-573.name: [Z+] Luma Stamper+
afterz-573.description: Trích xuất một mặt nạ từ lớp dựa trên độ sáng của các pixel trong lớp, tùy ý loại bỏ nhiễu ở các vùng cực sáng và tối của lớp, sau đó sử dụng mặt nạ để đóng một màu đồng nhất vào dự án.

afterz-575.name: [Z+] Fractal ZoomTrails
afterz-575.description: Adds zooming fractal trails with chromatic shift and radial blur.

afterz-576.name: [Z+] Mixer HSL
afterz-576.description: Adjusts hue, saturation, luminance and exposure.

afterz-578.name: [Z+] 3D Particles
afterz-578.description: Procedural glowing particles rotating in 3D space

afterz-579.name: [Z+] BCC Lensblur
afterz-579.description: Lens Blur filter emulates a lens blur defocus/rackfocus effect where out of focus highlights of an image clip take on the shape of the lens diaphragm.

afterz-581.name: [Z+] Pixel Sorter
afterz-581.description: Sorts the pixels of the layer into glitch streaks.

afterz-583.name: [Z+] VHS Tape
afterz-583.description: Generates a VHS tape noise overlay.

afterz-588.name: [Z+] Brush Sketch
afterz-588.description: Redraws the layer as a brush sketch.

afterz-592.name: [Z+] Shape Voronoi
afterz-592.description: Generates an animated Voronoi cell pattern.

afterz-595.name: [Z+] Wipe+
afterz-595.description: Tạo mặt nạ cho các phân đoạn hình chữ nhật từ các cạnh đối diện của lớp. Sử dụng hình động keyframe để tạo hiệu ứng chuyển tiếp kiểu gạt.

afterz-596.name: [Z+] Old Sharpen V1
afterz-596.description: Sharpens the layer with several noise styles.

afterz-597.name: [Z+] Old ColorBalance
afterz-597.description: Adjusts the red, green and blue balance of the layer.

afterz-600.name: [Z+] Broken Portrait
afterz-600.description: Shatters the layer into a broken glass mosaic with realistic cracks.

afterz-601.name: Book Fold 3D
afterz-601.description: Folds the layer along a hinge into a real perspective V shape, like a book opening or closing. Fold toward or away from the camera, move the hinge, shade the crease and light one page more than the other.

afterz-602.name: Fake Extrude
afterz-602.description: Fakes a solid 3D extrusion by stacking copies of the layer one behind another along the layer's own depth axis. Uses the real 3D position, Z and Rotation X / Y / Z of the layer itself (no linked Null needed) and the scene camera (Effect Camera Matrix patch), so the copies keep their true depth in perspective when the layer or the camera moves. Separate back and front layer counts, depth or per layer gap, start gap for an empty space next to the face, end scale, twist and end offset, side shade, near / far color, end opacity, face options and a flat 2D fallback.

afterz-603.name: Advanced Corner Pin
afterz-603.description: Pins the four corners of the layer anywhere with true perspective, or unpins a slanted surface back into a flat rectangle. Edit the corners by dragging them in the Warp Editor under Add Effect.

afterz-604.name: Highlight Sparkle
afterz-604.description: Pops twinkling star sparkles on the brightest parts of the layer: four (or eight) pointed rays with a soft glow, random size and timing, in one color or the color of the layer under them.

afterz-605.name: Ghost Echo
afterz-605.description: Zoomed ghost copies of the layer that grow out of it and fade away, as one ghost or an endless loop of echoes. Ghosts can be normal, black and white inverted, color inverted, an edge outline or a soft glow, tinted and blended over the layer.

afterz-606.name: Noise Crossfade Wipe
afterz-606.description: A soft crossfade wipe broken up by procedural noise: the layer dissolves into a color (or into transparency) along a direction, with smooth, grainy or blocky noise at the edge of the wipe.

afterz-607.name: Tear & Block Glitch
afterz-607.description: Fast digital glitch frames: a big horizontal tear that shifts part of the layer, colored bands with scanlines, datamosh blocks and static blocks, optional RGB split, firing at a set number of glitch steps per second with an adjustable chance.

afterz-608.name: Particle Dissolve 3D
afterz-608.description: The layer breaks into tiny particles along a noise map: each grain flies off in 3D toward (or away from) the camera, scatters with a flowing drift and fades, while a glowing edge can burn along the dissolve front.

afterz-609.name: Color Grading LR
afterz-609.description: Color grading wheels like Lightroom: tint the shadows, midtones and highlights (and the whole picture with Global) with their own hue, saturation and luminance, then set how the ranges blend and where the balance between shadows and highlights sits.

afterz-610.name: Manga Negative
afterz-610.description: Turns the layer into a high contrast black and white manga style negative (or positive), with edge sharpening, crushed blacks, clipped whites, an ink threshold or halftone dot look, two ink colors and film grain.

afterz-611.name: Diamond Checker Wipe
afterz-611.description: A checkerboard wipe made of rotated squares (diamonds at 45 degrees) that grow over the layer or shrink it away, with a direction gradient and a radial gradient so the squares sweep across, plus an optional fill color.

afterz-612.name: Orbit Gradient Lights
afterz-612.description: Two soft colored lights orbit around a center on opposite sides with exponential falloff and optional grain, blended over the layer with 22 blend modes for a dreamy moving gradient grade.

afterz-613.name: Black Hole
afterz-613.description: A whirling black hole with a glowing accretion disk, red to blue shifted light and a bright rim ("Singularity" by XorDev). Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-614.name: Simple Glitter
afterz-614.description: Sparse, sharp glitter sparkles made from two drifting noise layers multiplied together, like light catching tiny flakes. Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-615.name: Random Stars
afterz-615.description: Soft glowing colored orbs that float around on looping paths with bokeh like falloff and slowly cycling colors. Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-616.name: Space Ring
afterz-616.description: Rings of glowing particles that orbit, pulse and breathe in and out with a cosine color palette. Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-617.name: Bonfire Sparks
afterz-617.description: Realistic campfire embers: buoyant sparks rise from the bottom and slow down as they cool, curl and sway in the turbulent air, drift with the wind, flicker, shrink and fade from white-yellow through orange to deep red, with occasional little pops. Fully procedural, scrubbing and reverse work.

afterz-619.name: Lightning Storm
afterz-619.description: Several crackling lightning bolts that run across the layer, built from fractal noise lines that flow and bend, with a hot core and colored glow. Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-620.name: Neural Network
afterz-620.description: A light plexus network: glowing points drift on a jittered grid in several depth layers and link to their neighbors with thin lines that fade with distance, flying slowly toward the camera like a living neural network.

afterz-621.name: Particle Tunnel
afterz-621.description: Rings of 3D ball particles stream out of the distance and spread into a tunnel toward the camera, with depth of field blur, flicker and a five color palette. Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-622.name: Orbit Particles
afterz-622.description: A cloud of 3D ball particles that tumbles around its center in all three axes, with depth of field blur, strong flicker and a five color palette. Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-623.name: Wave Lines
afterz-623.description: Glowing horizontal and vertical lines that wave and cross like interfering signals; where several lines meet they burn from red to white. Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-624.name: Snowflakes
afterz-624.description: Detailed snowflakes with petals and rings on a Voronoi grid, each spinning at its own speed as they drift down over a soft winter sky. Ported from Shadertoy (iq / Steven An).

afterz-625.name: Sparkle Stars
afterz-625.description: Four pointed star sparkles that pop in, twist and fade on three drifting layers, flashing from rainbow colors to white. Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-626.name: Polytrace Pro
afterz-626.description: Rebuilds the layer as a low poly mosaic: triangles whose corners snap toward the edges of the picture, squares (pixel mosaic), hexagons, diamonds or Voronoi cells, each filled with the color of its cell, with optional facet shading, triangle outlines, jitter and blend modes.

afterz-627.name: ASCII Art
afterz-627.description: Turns the layer into ASCII characters: every cell is replaced by a 5 x 5 pixel character chosen by its brightness, in color or black and white (movAX13h). Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-628.name: ASCII Matrix
afterz-628.description: Turns the layer into a terminal style screen of tall characters, 12 symbols from a space to @ picked by brightness, in one glowing color (green by default). Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-629.name: Cross Glitch 2
afterz-629.description: Bursts of digital glitch: horizontal slices of random height shift left and right, blocks break apart, the frame shakes and flickers, with an optional RGB split, firing at random intervals. Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-630.name: Shake Lighter
afterz-630.description: A light camera shake like S_Shake: random noise plus a sine wave on X, Y, rotation and tilt, each with its own amount and frequency, scaled by global Amplitude, Frequency, Phase, Z Distance and Seed. Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-631.name: Shockwave
afterz-631.description: A ring shaped shockwave that bursts out of a point, bending the picture outward and flashing it brighter, then fading as it grows; repeats every period. Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-632.name: Voronoi Poly
afterz-632.description: Breaks the layer into Voronoi cells on up to four scales and blends them, a faceted polygon mosaic look. Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-633.name: Film Scratch
afterz-633.description: An old film look: 24 fps grain, dust and specks, vertical scratch lines that jump around, a curly hair that pops in, flicker and a vignette. Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-634.name: Outline Stroke
afterz-634.description: A clean outline stroke around the visible shape of the layer: outside, centered on the edge or inside, with width, softness, color, opacity and a stroke only option.

afterz-636.name: Slice Transition
afterz-636.description: The layer is cut into slices that each zoom (or slide) away with a staggered delay, blur while they move and fade out, in a chosen order and angle. Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-637.name: AllForOne Pattern
afterz-637.description: Four tiled patterns in one effect: Hypnotic Rings, Kawung batik, Tartan plaid and Square Ripple. Pick a Style, change the colors, size and speed. Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-638.name: AllForOne Transition
afterz-638.description: Many transitions in one effect: repeated shape grids (diamond, hexagon, circle, square, triangle, star, heart, plus, octagon, rhombus), hex tiles, pixel ring, linear, radial, iris, barn doors, blinds, mosaic, spiral and wave wipes, page roll, box flip, zoom, spin, swirl, pixelate, slide, card flip and ripple. Ported from Shadertoy.

afterz-643.name: Radial Blur Advance
afterz-643.description: Zoom and spin blur around a movable center with a clear focus area, chromatic smear that splits the colors along the blur, highlight boost and smooth dithered samples.

afterz-644.name: Bokeh Overlay
afterz-644.description: Floating out-of-focus bokeh lights in three depth layers: circle, hexagon, octagon or heart shapes with bright rims, soft edges, chromatic fringe, twinkle and drift, colored by palette or by the layer.

afterz-645.name: Advance Shadow
afterz-645.description: The opposite of Contour Light Advance: a normal map made from the layer shape (and optionally its brightness) shades the edges that face away from the light, with wrap, a second shadow, ambient occlusion, a soft light rim on the lit side and a contact shadow cast outside the contour, for realistic shadowing.

afterz-646.name: Flutter
afterz-646.description: Makes the layer flutter: Wave mode ripples it like a flag or cloth in the wind with shading, Fly Away mode breaks it into square or triangle pieces that flip, spin and flutter away one after another like paper in the wind.

afterz-648.name: Halfdot Shape
afterz-648.description: Halftone made of repeating shapes: every grid cell draws a shape picked at random from the enabled set (circle, square, triangle, diamond, star, heart, hexagon, cross) in a random palette, hue or layer color, sized by the layer brightness or alpha.

afterz-649.name: Lowpoly Stroke
afterz-649.description: Faceted low poly stroke: the outline around the layer is cut into straight polygon edges with random spikes and corners every Poly Sample, re-rolled by seed or over time, filled solid or with low poly facets.

afterz-650.name: Clarity
afterz-650.description: Adds or removes midtone local contrast like the Clarity slider in Lightroom, with an adjustable radius, midtone focus and halo reduction; 0 keeps the original look.

afterz-651.name: Dehaze
afterz-651.description: Removes or adds atmospheric haze like the Dehaze slider in Lightroom, from a dark channel haze map with automatic or custom haze color, edge refine and shadow protection; 0 keeps the original look.

afterz-652.name: Lift Gamma Gain
afterz-652.description: Color wheels for shadows (Lift), midtones (Gamma), highlights (Gain) and the whole image (Offset), each with a color hue, color amount and brightness master like a grading suite; 0 keeps the original look.

afterz-653.name: RGB Curves
afterz-653.description: Smooth tone curves for Master, Red, Green and Blue with a movable black output, three free points (input and output) and a white output per curve, like RGB Curves in Lumetri; the default straight curves keep the original look.

afterz-654.name: Black & White Mixer
afterz-654.description: Converts the layer to black and white with its own brightness for reds, yellows, greens, cyans, blues and magentas like Black and White in Photoshop, with an optional tint; 0 Amount keeps the original look.

afterz-655.name: Parallax Stars (Camera Link)
afterz-655.description: Procedural parallax star field that follows the scene camera or this layer's null parent in X, Y, Z and rotation. Needs Patcher > Effect Camera Link ON. Use it as a template for any camera linked effect.

afterz-656.name: StarGlow Parent
afterz-656.description: Glowing star particles with real 3D parallax. Stars sit at different depths and stay fixed in the scene, so moving or turning the camera or a null parent shifts them in X, Y, Z and orientation. Sizes are in pixels, so Scale 1 looks the same on any layer size. Camera data needs Patcher > Effect Camera Link ON; the Camera Offset XYZ and Orientation params work without it.

afterz-657.name: Camera Matrix Test
afterz-657.description: Checks the Effect Camera Matrix patch: draws a 3D axis gizmo and cube on this layer and a world floor grid with the real camera matrices, so you can see they stay glued to the layers when the camera or a null turns. Also a template for matrix based effects.

afterz-658.name: Particular Lite
afterz-658.description: Light 2D particle emitter: point, box or ellipse emitter with velocity, cone spread, gravity, wind, drag, wander, size and color over life, stretched sparks, pre-roll and a seamless loop. Scrubbing and reverse always work.

afterz-669.name: 3 Color Gradient Pro
afterz-669.description: Upgraded 3 color gradient overlay: linear, radial, angular, diamond, reflected or square shape, three colors with alpha and their own positions, smoothness from soft to hard bands, perceptual (OKLab) or RGB color mixing, posterize steps, repeat or mirror, scrolling animation, dither against banding, scale, angle and position, and Normal, Layer, Multiply, Screen, Overlay, Soft Light, Color or Add blending with Alpha and Alpha Comp.

afterz-670.name: Bar Color Palette
afterz-670.description: Shows a row of color blocks over the layer as a color palette reference: custom colors, colors picked from the layer or ready made palettes, with block count, block size, gap between blocks, rounded corners and border, a background bar with padding, corner radius and soft shadow, anchored at the bottom center by default, with position, scale, angle and blending.

afterz-671.name: Find Edges Clean
afterz-671.description: A cleaner Find Edges: the picture is smoothed first to kill noise, edges are found with a Scharr filter on brightness and alpha, thinned to one pixel lines (Canny style) and cut with a soft threshold, then drawn with any line width, line color or the source color, on white, black, transparent or the original picture.

afterz-672.name: Smooth Bevel Gloss
afterz-672.description: A real glossy smooth bevel: the layer shape is turned into a smooth 3D surface (smooth, round, chisel or soft pillow profile) and lit with diffuse light, a sharp Blinn specular, a clear coat hot spot and a studio environment reflection with Fresnel, so text and logos look like glossy plastic, candy, glass or metal.

afterz-673.name: 3D Floor Grid (Camera Link)
afterz-673.description: An infinite 3D floor grid that follows the real scene camera (Effect Camera Matrix patch): when the camera moves, turns or zooms the floor stays in place in 3D. Grid, dots, circular or stripe floors with sub lines, line width in screen pixels, glow, floor fill, distance fade, horizon glow and forward travel for synthwave looks. Falls back to a manual camera when the patch is off.

afterz-674.name: Wireframe Polyhedra Pro
afterz-674.description: A new take on Wireframe Stellations: glowing 3D wireframes of the five Platonic solids, stella octangula, small and great stellated dodecahedron, cuboctahedron, icosidodecahedron, a 4D tesseract turning through the fourth dimension and the two original morphing stellations. Free X, Y, Z rotation with auto spin, perspective, inner shell, explode and breathe, line width in pixels, neon glow with hot core, depth fade, running dashes, vertex dots and solid, depth, rainbow or layer colors.

afterz-675.name: CRT Monitor
afterz-675.description: A full CRT / TV screen look: 12 color styles, an RGB phosphor grid (dots or aperture grille), scanlines, chromatic aberration, signal ghosting, glow, sharpening, glitches (RGB shift, wavy lines, signal roll, blocks), static in the dark parts, a color signal bar and a curved TV screen with bezel.

afterz-676.name: NTSC Composite
afterz-676.description: Emulates an NTSC / VHS composite video signal: the picture is encoded onto a color subcarrier and decoded with a per line phase error, giving rainbow crosstalk, dot crawl, luma smear, a head switching tear at the bottom, tracking noise, snow and interlace flicker.

afterz-677.name: Deep Glow Multipass
afterz-677.description: A deep multi pass bloom: bright parts are picked in linear light, blurred at three growing radii on half size buffers, then stacked with exposure, a soft clip knee and tail weight, tinted and added with Add, Screen or Lighten. Optional soft drop shadow from the widest blur, Glow Only output and dither against banding.

afterz-678.name: Half Fold 3D
afterz-678.description: Folds one half of the layer over a straight hinge in real 3D, like turning a card or a page over: 0% flat, 50% standing up, 100% lying flipped on the other half. Any hinge angle and position, back side color, camera distance and lighting with shine and specular.

afterz-679.name: Warp Styles
afterz-679.description: A text style warp with 15 shapes: Arc, Arc Lower, Arc Upper, Arch, Bulge, Shell Lower, Shell Upper, Flag, Wave, Fish, Rise, Fish Eye, Inflate, Twist and Squeeze, on the horizontal or vertical axis, with extra horizontal and vertical distortion and edge tiling.

afterz-680.name: Penta GradMap
afterz-680.description: Maps the brightness of the layer to a five color gradient with movable stops, eight brightness sources, gamma, contrast and brightness of the gradient, zone strength for shadows, midtones and highlights, seven blend modes, hue, saturation and luminance preserve, color shift and a quick duotone mode.

afterz-681.name: Advanced Invert
afterz-681.description: Color inversion with 16 modes: full invert, luminance only, hue rotate 180, single channels and channel pairs, desaturated negative, soft gamma invert, shadows / highlights / midtones only, film color negative and solarize, plus amount, threshold, brightness, contrast, saturation and blend.

afterz-682.name: Color Steal
afterz-682.description: Steals the color grade of the layers below and puts it on this layer: matches mean and contrast of brightness and color (Reinhard style in YUV), with chroma strength, luma preserve and contrast match. Only the visible pixels of both are measured.

afterz-683.name: Flicker Pro
afterz-683.description: Makes the layer flicker like a bad light or an old projector: random, smooth random, pulse or random pulse brightness, separate red, green and blue flicker, a strobe with adjustable width, bias, phase and seed, with base brightness, contrast, saturation and blend.

afterz-684.name: Storm Clouds
afterz-684.description: Dark thunderstorm clouds lit from inside by lightning: drifting fractal clouds with soft self shadow, random flashes that strobe and light up the cloud around them, crackling white electric veins inside the lit cloud, and optional forked lightning bolts striking down. Sky color, cloud color, coverage, detail, flash rate, length, size, color and blending.

afterz-685.name: Light Leak Dispersion
afterz-685.description: Prism light leaks with real rainbow dispersion: every wavelength is drawn a little shifted, so light splits into rainbow edges like light through a crystal or lens. Prism streaks, rainbow burst rays around a dark center, a rainbow crescent ring with fine striations, soft prism blobs, or all mixed, with drift, flicker, gradient map and blending.

afterz-686.name: DNA Helix Shapes
afterz-686.description: A rotating 3D DNA double helix built from repeating geometric shapes: circles, squares, triangles, diamonds, hexagons, stars, plus signs or a mix, filled or outlined and spinning, joined by line or dotted rungs with a dotted center spine. Depth scaling and fade, twist, flow, rainbow, gradient, strand or single colors with glow.

afterz-687.name: 3D Floor Grid
afterz-687.description: A 3D grid world that lives in the layer's own 3D space like Particular: parent the layer to a Null and rotate the Null in X / Y / Z and the floor turns with it, while the real scene camera (Effect Camera Matrix patch) looks at it in true perspective. Floor, ceiling, tunnel or room planes, infinite or a board cut on the grid like a chessboard, grid, dots, circular or stripe styles, sub lines, checker fill, screen-pixel line width, glow, RGBA floor and background colors, distance fade, wall shade, switchable horizon glow and forward travel.

afterz-695.name: Venetian Blinds AE
afterz-695.description: Wipes the layer away in strips like closing blinds, with any direction, strip width and feather.

afterz-696.name: Card Wipe AE
afterz-696.description: Splits the layer into a grid of cards that flip over one after another to reveal the back side.

afterz-697.name: Twister AE
afterz-697.description: Twists the layer like a ribbon around an axis until it flips over to the back side.

afterz-698.name: Twirl AE
afterz-698.description: Rotates the layer around a center point, turning more near the center and less toward the edge of the radius.

afterz-699.name: Page Turn AE
afterz-699.description: Curls the layer over like turning the page of a book, showing the paper back side and a soft shadow.

afterz-703.name: Scribble AE
afterz-703.description: Fills the shape of the layer with animated hand-drawn scribble strokes, with write-on and wiggle.

afterz-704.name: Shine AE
afterz-704.description: Adds volumetric light rays that stream out of the bright areas of the layer, with shimmer and color presets.

afterz-705.name: Scale Wipe AE
afterz-705.description: Stretches the pixels on one side of a center line outward until they smear into streaks, like CC Scale Wipe.

afterz-706.name: Signal AE
afterz-706.description: Emulates a weak analog TV / VHS composite signal: limited luma bandwidth, smeared chroma, per-line luma, chroma and hue noise, sharpening halos, dot crawl and head-switching noise. Snow, tracking, jitter, roll, ghosting and scanlines are still there as options.

afterz-707.name: Line Sweep AE
afterz-707.description: Wipes the layer with a row of parallel strips that sweep across one after another, like CC Line Sweep.

afterz-708.name: Grid Wipe AE
afterz-708.description: Wipes the layer through a grid of tiles that close one after another from the center, like CC Grid Wipe.

afterz-709.name: Glass Wipe AE
afterz-709.description: Wipes the layer along a gradient while the edge of the wipe bends the picture like melting glass, like CC Glass Wipe.

afterz-710.name: Block Dissolve AE
afterz-710.description: Makes the layer disappear in random blocks with separate block width and height, feather and soft edges, like the After Effects Block Dissolve.

afterz-711.name: Threshold RGB AE
afterz-711.description: Turns each color channel fully on or off with its own threshold, for bold pop-art colors, like the After Effects Threshold RGB.

afterz-712.name: Plastic AE
afterz-712.description: Turns the layer into a shiny embossed plastic or metal surface lit by a light, using its brightness or alpha as the height, like CC Plastic.

afterz-713.name: Burn Film AE
afterz-713.description: Burns holes into the layer like overheated film in a projector, with glowing edges and charred rims, like CC Burn Film.

afterz-715.name: Scatterize AE
afterz-715.description: Scatters the pixels of the layer into a cloud of random grains, with a separate twist for the left and right side, like CC Scatterize.

afterz-716.name: Organic Strands AE
afterz-716.description: Grows animated organic strands like hair, roots or fibers from a point, line or circle, with bend noise, taper, color gradient and glow, like BCC Organic Strands.

afterz-717.name: Data Glitch AE
afterz-717.description: Corrupts the layer like broken video data: compression blocks, scan line smears, scrambled blocks, offset bands and glitch rectangles, per RGB or YUV channel, like Rowbyte Data Glitch.

afterz-718.name: Deep Glow AE
afterz-718.description: Physically based glow with a long natural falloff, per-channel threshold like After Effects, per-channel radius, chromatic aberration, Mono, Duo or Color tint and tonemapping, like Deep Glow 2.

afterz-719.name: Displacer Pro AE
afterz-719.description: Advanced displacement map: pushes the layer by the layer below, itself or animated noise, directionally, radially, by RG vectors or by the map slope, with map blur, smooth steps and chromatic dispersion, like Displacer Pro.

afterz-720.name: Pixel Sorter 2 AE
afterz-720.description: Sorts runs of pixels by luminance, hue, saturation or a color channel along any angle, with a threshold range, span length and randomness, for the classic glitch-art pixel sort, like AE Pixel Sorter 2.

afterz-721.name: Spotlight AE
afterz-721.description: Shines a theatrical spotlight cone onto the layer from a light point toward a target, with soft edges, ambient darkness and blend modes, like CC Spotlight.

afterz-722.name: Light Sweep AE
afterz-722.description: Sweeps a band of light across the layer with a glinting highlight along its edges, for logo shines and glossy reveals, like CC Light Sweep.

afterz-723.name: Blob Tracker AE
afterz-723.description: Finds bright, dark or detailed spots in the layer every frame and marks them with tracking boxes, connecting lines and number labels, for the trendy blob tracking look, like Tracery.

afterz-725.name: Burning Wipe AE
afterz-725.description: Burns the layer away with a flickering fiery edge that sweeps across it, leaving scorched char and glowing embers, to reveal what is below, like the After Effects burn wipe.

afterz-726.name: Smear AE
afterz-726.description: Drags part of the layer from one point to another like wet paint pushed with a finger, with reach, radius and softness, like CC Smear. Liquid Drip mode pulls the layer at From down toward To like melting paint, as animated tapered drips.

afterz-727.name: Lens Flare AE
afterz-727.description: Cinematic lens flare with glow, anamorphic streak, starburst rays, halo ring and a trail of ghosts across the frame, with Classic, Anamorphic, Sun and Cool presets, like Sapphire S_LensFlare.

afterz-728.name: Shake AE
afterz-728.description: Camera shake like Sapphire S_Shake: separate X, Y, Z and Tilt shake with random and wave parts, Normal / Twitchy / Jumpy style, per-channel RGB shake, motion blur, wrap modes, mask and crop.

afterz-729.name: Glint AE
afterz-729.description: Adds sparkling star glints with 4, 6 or 8 rays on the bright spots of the layer, with source, white or rainbow colors, like Sapphire S_Glint and S_GlintRainbow.

afterz-730.name: Zap AE
afterz-730.description: Electric lightning bolts between two points with jagged branches, a hot core and a colored glow that crackle and re-strike over time, like Sapphire S_Zap.

afterz-731.name: Aurora AE
afterz-731.description: Procedural northern lights: waving curtains of glowing rays that fade from a bright base up into the sky, with two colors, several layers and slow evolution, like Sapphire S_Aurora.

afterz-732.name: Light Leak AE
afterz-732.description: Warm film light leaks: soft colored blobs of light drifting over the frame with a glowing edge burn and gentle flicker, with Warm, Sunset, Cool, Rainbow and custom palettes, like BCC Light Leaks.

afterz-734.name: Dissolve Glow AE
afterz-734.description: Dissolves the layer into the layer below through a bright blooming glow that peaks in the middle of the transition, smooth, by luminance or by noise, like Sapphire S_DissolveGlow.

afterz-735.name: Film Damage AE
afterz-735.description: Old film look: grain, dust and dirt specks, running scratches, hair, flicker, gate weave, burn blotches, vignette and a faded tint, all changing every film frame, like BCC Film Damage.

afterz-736.name: Mesh Warp AE
afterz-736.description: Bends the layer with a smooth 3 x 3 to 5 x 5 mesh, like Mesh Warp in After Effects. Drag the mesh points in the Warp Editor under Add Effect.

afterz-737.name: Glitchify AE
afterz-737.description: Digital glitch storm: shifting blocks, RGB split, color corruption, scan line tears, pixelated patches and noise that burst and change over time, like Red Giant Universe Glitchify.

afterz-738.name: Cross Glitch AE
afterz-738.description: Digital glitch bursts like BCC Cross Glitch: block damage with compression patterns, shifted and jittered line bands, frame shake with RGB split and brightness / saturation flicker. Runs by itself on a glitch interval or works as a transition to the layer below.

afterz-739.name: Lens Blur AE
afterz-739.description: Real camera lens blur with shaped bokeh: circle, polygon blades, star, heart, ring or cross iris, boosted highlights, chromatic fringe and depth from the layer below, tilt shift or radial focus, like BCC Lens Blur.

afterz-740.name: TV Damage AE
afterz-740.description: Broken analog TV: snow noise, scan lines, rolling vertical hold with a dark bar, horizontal jitter, wavy lines, a tracking tear band, ghosting, color bleed and flicker, like BCC TV Damage.

afterz-741.name: Caustics AE
afterz-741.description: Procedural water caustics: a moving net of bright light lines like sunlight on a pool floor, with detail, sharpness, color dispersion and refraction that also bends the layer, like Sapphire S_Caustics.

afterz-742.name: Scanlines AE
afterz-742.description: CRT scan lines over the layer: line spacing, width, softness, angle and scrolling, with RGB stripe, shadow mask or interlaced modes, line blur and brightness compensation, like Sapphire S_Scanlines.

afterz-743.name: Digital Damage AE
afterz-743.description: Corrupted digital video: random rectangles of the picture jump sideways, smear their edge pixels, turn into big compression pixels, shift colors and split channels, changing several times per second, like Sapphire S_DigitalDamage.

afterz-745.name: RimLight AE
afterz-745.description: After Effects style rim light: lights the contour of the layer from a direction, a point or all around, with wrap, a second colored rim light, background light wrap, back shading, light spill outside the edge and a soft ambient shadow.

afterz-747.name: Anamorphic Flare AE
afterz-747.description: Long anamorphic lens flare like a cinema lens: hot core, a very long horizontal streak with thin cyan and violet lines, starburst rays and a row of small ghosts and rings, with Blue, Gold, Teal-Magenta, Red, White and custom colors.

afterz-748.name: Dust Overlay AE
afterz-748.description: Dust, bokeh and film dirt overlay: floating dust specks, soft bokeh discs, flickering film specks with blocks, hairs and scratches, a dirty lens and a mix of all, with depth layers, drift, twinkle and palettes.

afterz-749.name: Glimmer Particle AE
afterz-749.description: Glowing particle sparkles in 9 modes: Sparkle, Glitter, Fairy Dust, Firefly, Burst, Vortex, Meteor, Rain Glow and Mixed, with star rays, glow, twinkle, trails, palettes, a center point and depth layers.

afterz-750.name: AutoPaint AE
afterz-750.description: Repaints the layer as a hand-painted picture with flowing brush strokes: Van Gogh swirls, Oil, Pastel, Watercolor and Pointillism, coarse-to-fine brush layers, bristle texture, impasto lighting, outlines, canvas texture and a paint-in progress.

afterz-751.name: Fractal Noise AE
afterz-751.description: After Effects style Fractal Noise: Basic, Turbulent, Dynamic and Max fractal types, Block, Linear and Spline noise, contrast, overflow, transform, sub settings and a seamless looping Evolution.

afterz-752.name: Turbulent Displace AE
afterz-752.description: After Effects style Turbulent Displace: Turbulent, Bulge, Twist (plus Smoother versions), Vertical, Horizontal and Cross displacement with edge pinning, complexity and a seamless looping Evolution.

afterz-753.name: Ink Splash AE
afterz-753.description: Reveals or hides the layer with spreading ink splats: rough organic edges, tendrils, flying droplets and an ink rim, like the ink splash transitions in After Effects.

afterz-754.name: Ripple AE
afterz-754.description: Water ripples spreading from a center: continuous waves or a single drop, with wavelength, speed, damping, refraction and light highlights on the wave slopes, like BCC Ripple.

afterz-755.name: Square Break 3D AE
afterz-755.description: Breaks the layer into a grid of squares that flip, spin and fly away in 3D with perspective, lighting and a stagger order, like the 3D shatter / card break transitions in After Effects.

afterz-756.name: Pixel Wipe AE
afterz-756.description: A clean wipe whose edge breaks into random pixel blocks: blocks near the edge leave a little earlier or later, so the wipe front looks blocky and digital, like the Pixel Wipe transitions.

afterz-757.name: Digital Block Wipe AE
afterz-757.description: A normal linear wipe with a band of colorful flickering digital block noise riding on the wipe edge, like digital block wipe transitions.

afterz-758.name: Checkerboard Wipe AE
afterz-758.description: Wipes the layer away in a checkerboard: one set of squares goes first, the other set follows, each square wiping, shrinking, spinning or fading, with an order across the board, like the Checkerboard Wipes transitions.

afterz-759.name: HoloMatrix AE
afterz-759.description: Sci-fi hologram with Matrix digital rain: tinted see-through hologram with edge glow, moving scanlines, interference bands, flicker, RGB split and glitch bands, plus falling code columns inside the layer shape, the whole layer or around it, with many color presets.

afterz-760.name: Advance Pencil Sketch AE
afterz-760.description: Turns the layer into a hand drawn pencil sketch: clean outlines, tone based hatching and cross hatching, paper grain, smudge, colored pencil mode and boil animation.

afterz-761.name: Etching AE
afterz-761.description: Engraving / etching look like old banknotes and book prints: parallel ink lines that get thicker in dark areas and bend with the picture, optional cross lines, outlines and paper tint.

afterz-762.name: 8Bit AE
afterz-762.description: Retro 8-bit / pixel art look: big pixels, color reduction with your own palette of up to 8 colors or automatic levels, ordered dithering, pixel outlines and scanlines.

afterz-763.name: Sharpen AE
afterz-763.description: Multi scale sharpening like Sapphire S_Sharpen: the picture is split into tiny, small, medium and large detail levels from the Small Detail Size, each level is boosted by its own scale, strong edges are protected by the Edge Threshold so they do not ring, with separate luma, chroma and red / green / blue amounts, a mask from the layer's own luma or alpha with blur and invert, opacity and a detail view.

afterz-764.name: Frosted Glass AE
afterz-764.description: Looks through frosted or iced glass: grainy diffusion scatter, soft blur, ice crystal cracks or bathroom glass ripples, haze, tint and a clear area you can wipe, like the frosted glass effects in After Effects.

afterz-765.name: Rainy AE
afterz-765.description: Realistic rain on a window with two modes, Drops and Streams: drops that stick, then slip down in winding paths, leave wet trails and tiny beads behind, refract an upside-down view like real lenses, on top of beaded static droplets and fogged glass that the water wipes clean.

afterz-767.name: Scatter Shatter AE
afterz-767.description: Breaks the layer like a cracked heart or smashed glass: shards spread out from an impact point, cracks open with a grainy spray edge like the After Effects Scatter effect, then the shards push out, turn, fall and fade. Shard count, rings, randomness, crack width and color, edge grain, whole layer scatter grain, stagger and shading.

afterz-768.name: Saber AE
afterz-768.description: Energy saber glow that follows the shape of the layer, like Video Copilot Saber: a hot core along the outline or over the whole shape, a three layer glow with intensity, spread and bias, presets, start and end reveal, Vegas style running segments, flicker and animated noise distortion. Works great on text and logos.

afterz-769.name: Seamless Transition AE
afterz-769.description: Flow style seamless camera transitions used in velocity edits: zoom in, zoom out, spin, whip pan in four directions, stretch and roll zoom, with accelerate and decelerate easing, mirrored edges, built in motion blur, RGB split and a flash at the cut. Works on the layer itself or on the layers below like an adjustment layer.

afterz-770.name: Tile Scramble AE
afterz-770.description: Cuts the layer into a grid of tiles and scrambles them several times per second, like Sapphire S_TileScramble: swap tiles, shift whole rows or columns, or nudge each tile, with scramble amount, displace range, tile gaps, random flips and turns, per tile color shift and mirrored, repeated or clear edges.

afterz-771.name: Gradient Wipe AE
afterz-771.description: Wipes the layer away following the brightness of a gradient, like the After Effects Gradient Wipe: dark parts go first, bright parts last. The gradient can be the layer itself, the layers below, or a built in linear, radial, angular, diamond or fractal noise map, with softness, contrast, invert, a glowing burn edge and clear or color fill.

afterz-772.name: Heat Distortion AE
afterz-772.description: Rising heat haze like Video Copilot Heat Distortion: animated wobbling refraction that drifts upward, with wave size, stretch, turbulence, rise speed and angle, chromatic dispersion, shimmer and haze blur, limited by a bottom up, top down, luma or center mask.

afterz-773.name: CC Ball Action
afterz-773.description: Turns the layer into a grid of shaded 3D balls colored by the layer, like CC Ball Action: grid spacing and ball size, scatter in 3D with instability, rotation around X, Y, Z or combined axes, twist by radius, horizontal or vertical position, perspective and lighting with ambient and specular.

afterz-774.name: CC Card Dance
afterz-774.description: Splits the layer into a grid of 3D cards whose position, rotation and scale are driven by two gradient maps, like After Effects Card Dance: each of X, Y, Z position, X, Y, Z rotation and X, Y scale picks Gradient 1, Gradient 2 or random with a multiplier and offset. Gradients can be the layer brightness, the layers below, linear, radial, animated noise or waves. Back side shows the layer or a color, with perspective and lighting.

afterz-775.name: Echospace AE
afterz-775.description: Repeats the layer in real 3D like Trapcode Echospace: every instance is moved, turned and scaled from the one before it (linear or cumulative, so spirals, tunnels, fans and stairs come out by themselves), drawn around the layer's own position (Z included) and seen through the scene camera in perspective. Position and Z offset, rotation X / Y / Z, scale per instance, opacity falloff, start / end color, draw order and a manual camera fallback.

afterz-776.name: RGB Curves Pro
afterz-776.description: Smooth tone curves for Master, Red, Green and Blue with 1 to 8 free points per curve (default 4) plus black and white output, like RGB Curves in Lumetri. Edit it with the Curves Editor under Add Effect; the default straight curves keep the original look.

afterz-777.name: Depth Relight
afterz-777.description: Relights a flat picture with its depth map: surface normals come from the depth, a point light with position, height, color, intensity and falloff lights it with diffuse and specular shine, and the depth casts soft shadows away from the light.

afterz-778.name: Depth Matte
afterz-778.description: Cuts the picture by depth: only the parts between a near and a far depth stay (soft edge), so a subject can be pulled out from its background or the background kept alone, shown as a cutout, a white matte or over a color.

afterz-779.name: Depth 3D Photo
afterz-779.description: Turns a flat picture into a moving 3D photo with its depth map: a parallax camera move (circle, swing, dolly or manual) where near parts slide more than far parts and hide what is behind them, with focus depth, amount, dolly zoom, auto progress and edge fill by stretching.

afterz-780.name: Depth Blur
afterz-780.description: Lens blur by depth (depth of field): one depth stays sharp, everything nearer or farther melts into round bokeh, with focus depth and range, separate near and far blur, falloff, bokeh shape, bright highlight bokeh and a focus view.

afterz-781.name: Depth Fog
afterz-781.description: Fog and haze by depth: the farther a part is, the more it fades into the fog color, with near and far depth, density, curve and moving fog noise for drifting mist.

afterz-784.name: Raindrop Stream
afterz-784.description: Water drops run down the layer like rain on a window: every drop bends the picture under it like a small lens and drags a wet smeared tail behind it, with tail length, wiggle, stop and go pauses and drop patterns.

afterz-785.name: Twitch 2
afterz-785.description: Quick random jolts that knock the layer around its own center: jump, tilt and zoom, sharp or smooth, fading out after a hit, with Punch / Hand Cam / Jitter styles.

afterz-786.name: Glow Pro
afterz-786.description: Layered bloom in linear light through six blur sizes: soft wide haze or a tight white hot saber line, glow from highlights or the full layer, core heat, saturation, tint, chromatic spread, flicker and border fade.

afterz-787.name: Audio Visualizer Pro
afterz-787.description: Music visualizer that moves with NmTools Audio Keys: capsule bars (Spotify style), smooth glowing wave, floating bars, bars, line or dots, on a straight line or a ring (arc and spin), mirrored or not, growing up, down or both ways, with beat punch, color modes, background color, glow and hue shift.

afterz-788.name: Blend Mode Pro
afterz-788.description: Blends the layer with everything below it, as an effect. Alternative to the built-in Blending Mode with every Darken, Lighten and Contrast mode plus Difference, Exclusion, Subtract, Divide, Hue, Saturation, Color, Luminosity and Dissolve, with Strength, Swap, Invert, Luma / Color only, Saturation, Linear Blend, Channels and Blend If. Keep the layer blending on Normal.

afterz-789.name: Slider Control
afterz-789.description: Expression control: holds a value that Live Expression can read with effect('Slider Control')('Slider'). It does not change the picture. Keyframe it to drive many expressions at once.

afterz-790.name: Angle Control
afterz-790.description: Expression control: holds a value that Live Expression can read with effect('Angle Control')('Angle'). It does not change the picture. Keyframe it to drive many expressions at once.

afterz-791.name: Point Control
afterz-791.description: Expression control: holds a value that Live Expression can read with effect('Point Control')('Point'). It does not change the picture. Keyframe it to drive many expressions at once.

afterz-792.name: Color Control
afterz-792.description: Expression control: holds a value that Live Expression can read with effect('Color Control')('Color'). It does not change the picture. Keyframe it to drive many expressions at once.

afterz-793.name: Checkbox Control
afterz-793.description: Expression control: holds a value that Live Expression can read with effect('Checkbox Control')('Checkbox'). It does not change the picture. Keyframe it to drive many expressions at once.

afterz-794.name: Simple Distort
afterz-794.description: Glitch distortion in one effect: a built in fractal block noise (wide streaky blocks that change every frame) pushes the pixels of the layer like a displacement map, with offset, X / Y channel, edges, from center and invert.

afterz-795.name: Slice Swing
afterz-795.description: Cuts the layer into vertical or horizontal slices that swing one after another: slide along or across, pendulum, 3D flip or zoom, with order, waveform, stagger, loop or once, alternate direction, shading and gaps.

afterz-796.name: Audio Particles
afterz-796.description: Particles that react to music through NmTools Audio Keys: gravity, explode, fountain, orbit, vortex, drift, twinkle or tunnel, born from a point, line, ring, disc, box or the whole layer, as glow dots, circles, squares, stars, rings, sparks, hearts, diamonds, triangles, crosses or hexagons, with color modes, background color, gravity, wind, turbulence and blend modes.

afterz-798.name: Dropdown Menu Control
afterz-798.description: Expression control: a menu of 10 options that Live Expression can read with effect('Dropdown Menu Control')('Menu') (Option 1 = 1). It does not change the picture. Keyframe it to switch many expressions at once.

afterz-799.name: Layer Control
afterz-799.description: Expression control: points to another layer by its number in the timeline. Live Expression reads it as that layer, like AE: effect('Layer Control')('Layer').transform.position. It does not change the picture.

afterz-800.name: Audio Kaleidoscope
afterz-800.description: Videotron style kaleidoscope that moves on the beat: built in neon VJ patterns or the layer itself, folded into classic wedges, triangle, square or hex mirror tiles, an endless tunnel or fractal folds. Beat Motion steps the animation on every beat, blooms rings from the center, steps the colors or strobes like an LED wall, synced by BPM or NmTools Audio Keys, with an LED screen look.

afterz-803.name: Blown Dust
afterz-803.description: 3D dust particles blown through the frame by wind like a volumetric particle plugin: soft dots, sand streaks, tumbling ash flakes, bokeh specks or glowing embers on many depth layers with perspective, gusts, swirls or puffs, turbulence, lift, depth of field, motion streaks, flicker and two tone color.

afterz-804.name: Dust Wipe
afterz-804.description: Wipes the layer away and turns the wiped part into tiny particles of the layer's own colors that scatter and drift off like dust in the wind: linear, radial or random wipe with a noisy edge, glowing edge, fly distance, wind direction, turbulence, rise, shrink, speed variation, dust tint and reverse to build the layer up from dust.

afterz-806.name: VHS Comet Noise
afterz-806.description: VHS tape tracking error made of tiny comets: in rolling tracking bands the layer tears sideways line by line, smears and bleeds its colors, while bright white comet dashes with soft tails streak along the tape lines. Tape softness, noise grain, RGB split, line jitter, flicker, scanlines, depth layers, duo / single / rainbow comet colors and blend.

afterz-807.name: Fast Adjusting
afterz-807.description: Quick basic color adjustments like a photo editor: Brightness, Contrast, Highlights, Shadows, Whites, Blacks, Temperature, Tint, Saturation, Vibrance and Hue. Every slider at 0 keeps the original look.

afterz-809.name: Mixer HSL
afterz-809.description: Photo editor style color mixer: change the Hue, Saturation and Luminance of 8 color ranges (Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Aqua, Blue, Purple, Magenta) plus Hue vs Hue, Hue vs Sat, Sat vs Sat and Lum vs Sat curves. Everything at 0 keeps the original look.

afterz-810.name: Morphism Glass
afterz-810.description: Glassmorphism card: the layer shape becomes frosted glass with a soft blurred body (layer blur, gradient, aurora blobs or clear tint), lens refraction, light bevel with highlight, back light and specular, glass border, inner glow, inner shadow and drop shadow.

afterz-813.name: Levels AE
afterz-813.description: Levels like After Effects (Individual Controls): input black / white, gamma and output black / white for the whole image and for red, green, blue and alpha on their own, with clip to output switches.

afterz-814.name: Motion Tile AE
afterz-814.description: Repeats the layer as tiles like After Effects Motion Tile: tile size, tile center, output size bigger than the layer, mirror edges for seamless tiles and phase to offset every other row or column.

afterz-815.name: Chromatic Glow
afterz-815.description: A soft glow from the bright parts of the layer where red, green and blue spread to different sizes, giving rainbow fringes around the light, with threshold, size, color split, tint, glow only and source opacity.

afterz-816.name: Defocus Prism
afterz-816.description: Out of focus lens blur with a prism: shaped bokeh (circle or 3 to 8 blades), bright bokeh rings, highlight boost and red / blue split at the edges of every bokeh, with lens grain for an organic look.

afterz-817.name: Bleach Bypass
afterz-817.description: The film look of skipping the bleach bath: muted colors, punchy contrast and silver highlights, with silver amount, desaturation, film contrast, exposure in stops and mix.

afterz-818.name: Psyko Blobs
afterz-818.description: Psychedelic liquid color bands: soft drifting blobs mixed with the brightness of the layer are turned into cycling rainbow contour bands, with blob scale, strength, drift, color bands, cycle speed, brightness, saturation and original mix.

afterz-819.name: Channel Blur AE
afterz-819.description: Blurs red, green, blue and alpha each by its own amount like After Effects Channel Blur, in both directions or only horizontally or vertically, for color fringes, soft glows and dreamy looks.

afterz-820.name: Compound Blur AE
afterz-820.description: Blurs every pixel by the brightness of a blur map like After Effects Compound Blur: the layer below, the layer's own brightness, a linear or a radial gradient, with maximum blur, invert map and map contrast.

afterz-821.name: Tilt Shift Blur
afterz-821.description: Miniature / tilt shift look: a sharp band (or ellipse) of focus with smooth lens blur growing above and below it, adjustable center, angle, focus width and transition, glowing bokeh highlights and a saturation / contrast boost that makes real scenes look like tiny models.

afterz-823.name: Floor Contact
afterz-823.description: Grounds a 3D layer on the floor of the 3D world: cast shadow from a light (angle, height, softness growing with distance, fade), contact shadow where the layer touches the floor and a floor reflection. The floor comes from a 3D Floor Grid layer or the 3D World preview floor (Auto), or a Manual Floor Y. Needs Effect Camera Matrix ON.

afterz-824.name: Floor Underside
afterz-824.description: Solid underside of the 3D world floor: when the camera goes below the floor, the floor becomes a solid plane that hides the layers standing on it (a real floor seen from below), with optional grid lines. Uses the floor of a 3D Floor Grid layer or the 3D World. Needs Effect Camera Matrix ON.

afterz-825.name: Scene Light
afterz-825.description: Turns this layer into a light of the 3D scene (Directional sun or Point bulb) that lights 3D Model, Element 3D V3 and the shadow of Floor Contact. Shows a small marker in the editor preview only, never in the export. Made by NM Tools > Scene Light (Patcher Experimental Scene Light ON).

afterz-827.name: Emboss
afterz-827.description: Turns the layer into a raised relief lit from one direction, like After Effects Emboss and Color Emboss: flat areas become gray, edges facing the light get bright and the others dark (in color with Color mode). Direction, relief height, contrast and blend with the original.

afterz-828.name: Liquify
afterz-828.description: Liquify the layer with up to 6 brush strokes like Photoshop / After Effects Liquify: Push, Twirl, Pucker and Bloat, each with its own points, radius and strength, plus a master Amount to animate them. Points can be placed with Warp Editor.

afterz-829.name: Metal Texture
afterz-829.description: Generates a metal surface without any image texture: brushed steel, a rivet plate or a diamond tread plate, lit from one direction, with grain, grime, tint and the usual scale, rotate, blend and gradient map controls. Remake of [Z+] Metal Texture+.

afterz-830.name: Polar Warp 2
afterz-830.description: Advanced polar warp: Rect To Polar and Polar To Rect like the After Effects Polar Coordinates, an endless Tunnel, a log Spiral and a Swirl, with repeats, twist, zoom, spin and scroll animation, edge handling and anti-aliasing.

afterz-831.name: Glitch RGB 2
afterz-831.description: Advanced RGB glitch: sliced bands that jump sideways, RGB channel split (random, horizontal, vertical or radial), block damage with channel swap, scanlines, noise and flicker. Runs in glitch bursts with its own frame rate and seed.

afterz-832.name: Glitch Random Pattern 2
afterz-832.description: Advanced random glitch pattern: recursive glitch blocks that switch by themselves, with color modes (RGB, Mono, Duo, Layer Colors, Hue), softness, pixelation, stripes, layer displacement with RGB split and the Z+ blend block.

afterz-833.name: Glitch Mask Lines 2
afterz-833.description: Advanced digital mask glitch: damaged blocks and line bands that shift, lose their colors, turn into green or inverted lines and show RGB stripes, with RGB split and a glitch rate. Runs by itself in glitch steps.
